title: Guide explains the words we use
items: Guide in the Navigator now has a glossary of seven words, each with one plain line: Attested, Inferred, Reconstructed, Confidence view, Liberties, Sources and Jaunts.
It also answers two questions in a few sentences each: Is this real? and What does Reconstructed mean?
Where one of these words first appears, it is underlined with dots. Tap it to see what it means.
